comparisons: F64 compare chains and F32 trees: typed-ir-trees vs baseline; A64 pool: typed-ir vs typed-ir-trees. All variants compile against the same current runtime/context sources.
abi: Hosted AArch64 native ABI 7, module interface rev16, context 24 words; QOS retains ABI6, interface15, context16.
timing_scope: 31 paired rounds, one macOS AArch64 host and one hart; compiler comparison uses identical new runtime/context for all variants; old-context scheduling overhead not measured.

context_timing.scope: Direct hot switch, identical 24-word arrays, integer-only vs d8..d15 save/restore. Excludes scheduler and hart-layout cache effects.
